description: Create a new task in the project (visible to the team at once). Give a clear title and, in description, what done looks like. Check inventor_list_tasks first to avoid duplicates, or pass external_key so repeating the call updates the same task instead of adding another.

connected_resource.description: File or path this work touches

depends_on.description: Work item UUIDs that must finish first

external_key.description: Optional stable key to prevent duplicates

fields.description: Custom task fields by key (the project lists them in inventor_context → project.customization.fields); null clears one

name: inventor_create_task
